name: Mailercloud
description_en:
Mailercloud provides a marketing platform for campaigns and automation, with a separately described Email API product. The marketing workflow editor combines contact or campaign activity with subsequent messages and waits. Its operational status determines whether a workflow is draft, scheduled, running or completed.

An interaction rule, an available contact slot and an available email allowance all affect whether a follow-up happens. This profile explains those conditions with a campaign example and distinguishes broad product marketing from documented workflow controls. It does not measure inbox delivery or execute the API.
description_zh:
Mailercloud 提供用于活动和自动化的营销平台，另有单独介绍的 Email API 产品。营销流程编辑器把联系人或活动互动，与后续消息和等待结合；运行状态决定流程处于草稿、排程、运行还是完成。

互动规则、可用联系人容量和邮件额度都会影响后续是否发送。本文用具体活动示例解释这些条件，并区分营销宣传和文档中的流程控制，未测量收件箱投递或执行 API。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.

sections.title_en: Follow a campaign interaction into a concrete response
sections.title_zh: 把活动互动连接到具体回应
sections.en:
The advanced-workflow guide starts with an automation name and an Advanced flow, either blank or from a template. It distinguishes opens of a selected or any campaign, clicks in a selected campaign or particular link, non-opens, and an All path.

For an illustrative product announcement, a click on the technical guide could lead to a follow-up explaining setup. Decide whether any click or that specific link should qualify. A person clicking an unsubscribe or another unrelated destination is not the same business signal as requesting product guidance.
sections.zh:
高级流程指南先创建名称和 Advanced 流程，可从空白或模板开始。它区分指定或任意活动的打开、指定活动或特定链接的点击、未打开，以及 All 路线。

例如产品发布，点击技术指南后可发送安装说明。应明确是任意点击还是该链接点击才符合条件；点击退订或其他无关地址，不等于请求产品指导的业务信号。

sections.title_en: Non-click and non-open are different observations
sections.title_zh: 未点击与未打开是不同观察
sections.en:
The workflow guide defines Not Clicked as opening the email without clicking a link. Its non-open follow-up can wait a configured number of days. The separate wait-for-trigger guide gives a minimum one-hour waiting period after a campaign concludes for its not-clicked/not-opened case. These controls should not be collapsed into one timer.

For the announcement, decide how long the reader should have to respond before a reminder. Treat tracking as an observed signal and validate it with representative addresses; this research did not establish that an open or click records every real human interaction.
sections.zh:
流程指南把 Not Clicked 定义为打开邮件但未点击，未打开跟进可等待指定天数。独立的 wait-for-trigger 指南对其未点击／未打开情形，要求活动结束后至少等待一小时。这些控制不能合并为一个统一计时器。

在发布示例中，应决定读者有多久回应时间才发提醒。跟踪属于可观测信号，需用代表性邮箱验证；本次未确认打开或点击能记录所有真实人工互动。

sections.title_en: Scheduled, Active and Completed are operational states
sections.title_zh: 排程、活跃和完成是运行状态
sections.en:
The status guide says a published automation is Active; a future start time appears as Scheduled and becomes Active when reached. An end time makes the workflow Completed, after which it no longer functions. Drafts have not yet been published, and an active flow must be paused before editing and published again afterward.

Before a limited-time launch, inspect both start and end times and confirm the edited version is published. A saved draft or a Completed label is not evidence that new subscribers will still receive the intended follow-up. The guide does not establish detailed in-flight recovery semantics for every state change.
sections.zh:
状态指南说明已发布为 Active，未来启动显示 Scheduled，到时转 Active；到结束时间变为 Completed，之后不再运行。Draft 尚未发布，修改活跃流程前需暂停，修改后重新发布。

限时发布前应检查起止时间，并确认修改版已发布。草稿已保存或显示 Completed，不能证明新订阅者仍能收到后续。指南没有确认每种状态切换的详细进行中恢复语义。

sections.title_en: A valid external event can still be blocked by capacity
sections.title_zh: 外部事件有效也可能受容量阻挡
sections.en:
The quota article says automation uses the contacts and email allowance available under the subscription. Contacts added through forms, APIs or other means beyond available plan capacity do not trigger the workflow. The bulk-enrollment article permits imported or existing contacts, while the current price matrix places bulk automation in paid tiers.

During a migration, test one existing contact and one new signup within the actual purchased capacity. Separately inspect the import result and workflow enrollment; an accepted file is not proof that every imported address was eligible for automation.
sections.zh:
额度文章说明自动化受订阅中的联系人及邮件额度约束。通过表单、API 或其他方式新增且超过套餐容量的人，不会触发流程。批量进入文章允许导入和已有联系人，但当前价格表将批量自动化放在付费档位。

迁移时，应在真实购买容量内分别测试现有人和新订阅。导入结果与流程进入需分别检查，文件被接受不代表每个地址都符合自动化资格。

sections.title_en: Count contacts, sends and automations separately
sections.title_zh: 分别计联系人、发送与自动化
sections.en:
The current marketing matrix lists Free at $0 with 1,000 contacts, 12,000 monthly emails and one advanced automation. Its Premium example shows $10/month billed monthly, 5,000 contacts, unlimited sends and 25 advanced automations; Enterprise uses a custom offer and unlimited automation. A/B testing and AMP are shown only in paid columns.

If 1,000 contacts each receive ten announcements, that is 10,000 sends before follow-ups. This hypothetical example leaves only 2,000 Free sends. Confirm the current selected offer and plan interpretation: the same table labels the Free editor Basic while listing one advanced automation.
sections.zh:
当前营销套餐表列出 Free：$0、1,000 位联系人、每月 12,000 封及一个高级自动化；Premium 示例为月付 $10，5,000 位联系人、不限发送及 25 个高级自动化；Enterprise 单独报价并不限自动化。A/B 测试和 AMP 只在付费列。

假设 1,000 位联系人各收到十次通知，跟进前就用掉 10,000 次，只剩 2,000 次 Free 发送。应确认当前所选报价及套餐含义：同一表将 Free 编辑器称为 Basic，却又列出一个高级自动化。

sections.title_en: Marketing and API are separate sending evaluations
sections.title_zh: 营销与 API 分别评估
sections.en:
The pricing page offers separate Marketing Platform and Email API tabs and describes them as distinct products. The marketing matrix does not establish API sending rates, credentials or transactional retry guarantees. Native commerce and enterprise security are vendor-described surfaces whose exact account conditions need their own check.

Mailercloud is worth evaluating for an operator who can define interaction-based follow-ups and monitor capacity and publishing states. For critical application notices, evaluate the API’s current documentation and contract separately. No account, sending test, source license or self-hosting entitlement was verified.
sections.zh:
价格页为 Marketing Platform 和 Email API 提供独立入口，并称为不同产品。营销表不能证明 API 发送费率、凭据或事务重试保证。原生电商和企业安全也是厂商描述的范围，具体账户条件需另查。

能明确互动跟进并监控容量及发布状态的运营者，可评估 Mailercloud。关键应用通知应另查 API 现行文档及合同。本文未验证账户、发送、源码许可或自托管权利。
